requirements.text: This position requires a bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science or a related field. 3 years of experience as a Senior Web Engineer, Full Stack Software Engineer or in an occupation involving customer facing PHP in e-commerce. Additionally, the applicant must have employment experience with: (1) Software engineering principles including algorithm design and optimization, data structures implementation, design patterns (MVC), object-oriented programming, code complexity analysis, and software architecture best practices; (2) Full-stack development using PHP/Laravel backend with React frontend, MySQL database design, Eloquent/ORM familiarity, RESTful API development, and Linux server deployment (LAMP/LEMP stack); (3) Developing and maintaining e-commerce web applications, implementing features while ensuring secure transactions, data protection, and intuitive user interfaces; (4) SQL, designing relational DB schemas, and complex queries; (5) Using git in a team environment; and (6) Agile software development with Jira products: participating in sprint planning and retrospectives, implementing continuous improvement initiatives, code review processes, and contributing to team velocity improvements.
